name: Discrimination
criterion: macro-AUROC >= 0.90 and > best classical (hgb_ens), Holm p < 0.05

name: Subgroup validity
criterion: positive coverage >= 0.85 in each sex/age group with >= 30 positives

name: Shift restoration
criterion: M1 worst-class positive coverage at n=250 >= 0.87 at every site

name: Robustness
criterion: AUROC drop at 20 dB SNR <= 0.05 and positive coverage >= 0.85

name: Compute
criterion: ResNet1d CPU inference <= 100 ms per ECG (single model)

name: Data validity
criterion: official PhysioNet source, all checksums verified, mapping audit valid
